Chapter 673 - 673 Annihilation; Finally Meeting!

Chapter 673 - 673 Annihilation; Finally Meeting!

673 Annihilation; Finally Meeting!

Lin Fan ignored Hu Yixiao completely as he pointed at the mutated beast in front of him.

Another exotic beast turned into a bubble and disappeared.

Following that, Lin Fan pointed at a few more mutated beasts.

With each point, a strange beast disappeared completely.

Mysterious and tyrannical!

Hu Yixiao’s jaw dropped in shock.

When could SSS-class exotic beasts be dealt with so easily?

However, Lin Fan was frowning.

He still felt that it was too slow.

Lin Fan suddenly stretched out his hands.

In an instant, the exotic beasts that were roaring crazily and waving their claws ferociously all stopped moving as if they had been immobilized.

Then, Lin Fan spat out a single word, “Destroy!”

After a soft sound, all the exotic beasts, including dozens of SSS-class exotic beasts, all shattered like bubbles and disappeared without a trace.

The entire world fell silent!

Everyone’s mouth was wide open as they stared at Lin Fan in shock.

Hu Yixiao stammered, “You… You are…”

“Lin Fan.” After Lin Fan spat out these two words, he took a step forward and instantly came to Xia Xue’s side.

Xia Xue could not help but ask, “Are you Professor Lin from a thousand years ago?”

Everyone around pricked up their ears.

Obviously, they were also very curious about this.

Lin Fan nodded. “Yes.”

He did not want to tell any lies to Xia Xue.

Furthermore, this matter was nothing to Lin Fan.

Although everyone had already expected this, they were still shocked after hearing Lin Fan admit it.

Professor Lin!

That great man!

He had lived for more than 1,000 years!

In Xia Xue’s mind, she could not help but think of the scene of her meeting with Lin Fan.

No wonder the Imperial Hotel treated Lin Fan so politely.

No wonder Lin Fan had such a weird expression when she was introducing Jiangbei University to him, especially when she was introducing Lin Fan’s achievements.

No wonder he could solve the math problem so easily.

…

No wonder she felt so at ease when she was by his side.

Thinking of this, Xia Xue’s pretty face could not help but blush.

She stole a glance at Lin Fan and realized that he was also looking at her.

Xia Xue was even more shy, and she wanted to bury her head somewhere.

“Boom!”

At this moment, an unprecedented loud noise appeared in the depths of the forbidden land.

The powerful energy storm raised a cloud of dust.

Cracks appeared on the ground.

Moreover, the cracks were growing and expanding.

Following that, countless exotic beasts fled from the depths of the forbidden land.

This time, whether it was the number of exotic beasts, the aura they emitted, or the degree of violence, they all surpassed the previous few tides.

This feeling was as if there was something extremely terrifying behind them.

The students were so scared that their faces turned slightly pale.

Then, they all looked at Lin Fan.

Lin Fan frowned. “The depths of the forbidden area, this aura… They all seem familiar. What is it?”

As he spoke, he waved his hand.

The beasts that were running away disappeared.

It felt as if the previous beast tide was just an illusion.

An earth-shattering sound rang out in the depths of the forbidden area.

The vigorous energy surged like a tide.

Lin Fan’s eyes moved as he said in shock, “This feeling is… It’s them!”

Then, he was about to step out.

But soon, he thought of Xia Xue next to him.

So, he said, “Xia Xue, let’s go inside the forbidden area together.”

Inside the forbidden area?

That place was absolutely terrifying and dangerous.

Xia Xue did not hesitate at all and nodded directly. “Alright.”

As long as she was with Lin Fan, she would feel at ease.

Instantly, the two of them disappeared from where they were.

The next moment, Lin Fan and Xia Xue appeared in the depths of the forbidden land.

This place was filled with dense white fog, making it impossible for people to see the scenery in front of them.

Of course, this was only a problem ordinary people faced.

Lin Fan was not an ordinary person!

He stared straight ahead, his body trembling slightly.

He was excited!

That was because there was a huge pit under the white fog.

Inside the hole was an energy barrier.

There were many people lying inside the light barrier.

These people were all Lin Fan’s family and loved ones from a thousand years ago!

His grandpa, Lin Liqiang, his grandma, Zhang Guidan, his dad, Lin Tao, his mom, Dai Weixue, his sister, Lin Xiaoyao… His lovers, Xia Bing, Hu Tian, Han Tian, Song Jiaxin, Su Ningjing, Ling Rou, Qiu Ziqian, Huang Ling, Chen Xin, Xu Jingrou… All of them were here!

Lin Fan had missed them dearly during this period.

Now, they had finally appeared in front of him.

Moreover, looking at their condition, their bodies were still full of vitality.

All of them were still alive!

How could Lin Fan not be excited?

At this moment, the energy barrier in the hole suddenly shattered.

Lin Fan was worried that something unexpected might happen. Hence, he hurriedly poured vigorous life force into everyone’s bodies.

After a while, Lin Tao, Dai Weixue, Lin Xiaoyao, Han Tian, Hu Tian, and the others opened their eyes.

At first, they were still at a loss.

But soon, their gazes landed on Lin Fan.

“Lin Fan!”

“Lin Fan, is that really you?”

“This is great!”

Everyone shouted happily.

Hu Tian, Han Tian, Song Jiaxin, Su Ningjing, and the rest rushed toward Lin Fan.

Then, they either held his hands tightly or hugged him…

They had not seen each other for many years, and their feelings for each other were deep.

Lin Fan said softly, “It’s been hard on you all these years.”

“We didn’t suffer at all. We were just sleeping. When we woke up, we saw you,” Song Jiaxin said.

“Yes.” The women nodded.

Lin Fan said, “Right, why were you guys lying here?”

“It was Xia Xue and Xia Bing who helped us. That day, they said that you didn’t die. If we slept together, maybe we could see you again,” Song Jiaxin said happily.

Lin Fan nodded his head in realization.

From the super smart watch, he already knew that Xia Xue and Xia Bing had absorbed a lot of energy and thus had powerful strength.

Therefore, it was a reasonable explanation.

At this moment, he seemed to have thought of something and was about to turn around to ask.

Xia Bing, who was the only one lying on the ground, suddenly opened her eyes.

At the same time, the rolling white fog penetrated Xia Xue’s body.

It howled wildly, sending sand and stones flying everywhere.

The blue sky suddenly burst into a dazzling golden light.

The golden light continued to spread out and gradually formed a huge golden door with four golden words—’Congratulations on becoming an immortal!’
